title: Negative carbs ?
symptom: After entering negative carbs to correct overestimated carbs, the main screen shows negative carbs, and COB becomes negative. The negative carbs should erase carbs from COB but should not generate negative carbs.
cause: The thread does not explicitly identify a root cause, but it is implied that the negative carb entry causes the COB to go negative due to a bug in the calculation.
fix: A commit was suggested by MilosKozak: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/9f3cbe21505da570054f06f86dc8f2b0c6841d9a. Users were asked to test it, and one user reported they couldn't reproduce after that.
